store.name: AP House Geneva

image.alternateText: View of a Audemars Piguet boutique.

store.cquoteBoutiquePages: Step into our AP House, an innovative and intimate concept that embodies Audemars Piguet’s forward-thinking approach to retail. Located at Quai du Mont-Blanc 5, this temporary AP House is designed for discovery, conversation and shared experiences. A complement to our Geneva boutique, it is a welcoming space where refinement, comfort and hospitality come together to create memorable moments. Join a community where genuine connections and a shared passion for fine watchmaking are at the heart of the experience.
store.cdescriptionBoutiquePages:
Audemars Piguet’s forward-thinking approach to retail. Whether you wish to discover our watches, explore AP’s universe, or simply spend time with us, our doors are always open. 
Designed as a timeless space for lovers of the brand, the AP House was created in collaboration with some of the Manufacture’s most loyal clients, imagining how brand founders Jules Louis Audemars and Edward Auguste Piguet would deal with their clients if they were living in the 21st century, travelling the world and sharing their passion for beautiful watches. The result is a space where the comfort of home and the warmth of friendship take priority.

entity.cquoteBoutiquePages: Step into our AP House, an innovative and intimate concept that embodies Audemars Piguet’s forward-thinking approach to retail. Nestled in the city's historic Leuenhof, AP House Zurich invites you to explore the world of Audemars Piguet in the former banking hall of the iconic Leu Bank - a place where heritage and contemporary sophistication blend seamlessly. Join a community where genuine connections and a shared passion for fine watchmaking are at the heart of the experience.

image.alternateText: View of a Audemars Piguet boutique.

entity.cquoteBoutiquePages: Step into our AP House, an innovative and intimate concept that embodies Audemars Piguet’s forward-thinking approach to retail. Located in the iconic Garage Traversi on Via Bagutta, AP House Milan invites you to explore the intersection of heritage and innovation at the heart of Audemars Piguet. Discover the brand’s craftsmanship in a space where Milan’s rich cultural tapestry meets cutting-edge design. Join a community where genuine connections and a shared passion for fine watchmaking are at the heart of the experience.
entity.cdescriptionBoutiquePages:

The result is a space where the comfort of home and the warmth of friendship take priority.

On the occasion of Milan Design Week 2026, Audemars Piguet presents Crafting Time: When Design Shapes Movement. Taking place from 21 April to 3 May 2026, this immersive exhibition offers a cultural and educational journey through watch design, heritage, and craftsmanship.
